articles.title: A New Clue to the Puzzle of the Expanding Universe
articles.summary: Tiny magnetic fields from the early universe could help explain why two ways of measuring cosmic expansion disagree.

articles.title: How a Naked Mole-Rat Queen's Scent Keeps the Peace
articles.summary: Scientists found that a chemical made only by naked mole-rat queens stops other colony members from fighting or mating.

articles.title: A New Light-Powered Material Makes Hydrogen From Water
articles.summary: Oregon State chemists built a light-activated material that makes hydrogen from water without an extra expensive metal catalyst.
